concrete_next_controlled_experiment.minimal_change: Add opt-in in-memory monotonic stage records around the existing shared engine submit/worker/native/return boundaries, preserving one-worker execution. Capture exact submitted PCM count/hash and retain its bytes after the timed recognition. Buffer records and write them after each turn; no synchronous disk logging on the audio loop.
concrete_next_controlled_experiment.frozen_design: One fresh shared local stack, same pinned models/config/input WAVs and baseline,correction,correction,baseline room order: four rooms/six recognition requests, all retained. Keep prewarm, forced-deadline/cleanup protocol and current input scheduling unchanged. Hash model files before/after rather than during timed turns. No concurrent unrelated model experiment; disclose uncontrolled OS/background state.
concrete_next_controlled_experiment.measurements: Submit→worker-enter (queue), worker-enter→native-enter (setup/WAV), native-enter→return (recognition), native-return→worker-exit (cleanup), worker-exit→await-resume (scheduling), plus existing speech-end→transcript and exact segment identity; retain per-turn memory and loop watchdog witnesses.
concrete_next_controlled_experiment.decision_rule: If a slow interval recurs, classify only the measured dominant phase. If none recurs, report non-reproduction in6 requests and make no fixed/improved claim. Only then choose one isolated follow-up, such as replaying the exact saved segment with resident models idle versus explicit competing work.
concrete_next_controlled_experiment.limits: Instrumentation adds overhead; one small fixed-order repeat cannot estimate tail probability, establish a swap/native mechanism or show general latency improvement. No experiment is run by this audit.
